correctness.rationale: Since all mixed columns share a one-dimensional span, recovering file 1 requires either all u systematic columns or exactly one missing supported first-file coordinate, all b opposite support columns and at least one parity column; similarly for file 2. Poisson marking gives rate-1 independent systematic first arrival and rate-M parity first arrival, yielding the disjoint CDF (1−e^−t)^u + a e^−t (1−e^−t)^(u+b−1)(1−e^−Mt). Integration yields the harmonic-minus-beta formula and scale n for discrete draws. Positivity of beta plus H_s−s/(s+1)>2s/(2s+1) (s>=2), with separate u=1 or v=1 cases, proves the strict hyperbolic inequality for unbounded M. Independently solved exact subset-state recovery-time recurrences for all u,v<=3, all support sizes, M<=4 and checked rational formulas.
